evidenceQuoteFragments: don't go into Mr. McGregor's garden
questions.q: Where does Mrs. Rabbit tell the little rabbits not to go?
questions.zh: 兔妈妈叮嘱小兔子们不要去哪里？
options: Mr. McGregor’s garden / 麦格先生的花园
questions.explanation: Mrs. Rabbit warns them not to enter Mr. McGregor’s garden. / 兔妈妈警告他们不要进入麦格先生的花园。

evidenceQuoteFragments: went down the lane to gather blackberries
questions.q: What do Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-tail go to gather?
questions.zh: 弗洛普西、莫普西和棉尾巴去采什么？
questions.explanation: The three good little bunnies go down the lane to gather blackberries. / 三只听话的小兔子沿着小路去采黑莓。

evidenceQuoteFragments: First he ate some lettuces and some French beans
questions.q: What does Peter eat first in the garden?
questions.zh: 彼得进花园后先吃了什么？
options: Lettuces and French beans / 生菜和四季豆
Bread and milk / 面包和牛奶
questions.explanation: Peter first eats lettuces and French beans, and then some radishes. / 彼得先吃了生菜和四季豆，后来又吃了小萝卜。

evidenceQuoteFragments: round the end of a cucumber frame
questions.q: Who does Peter meet near the cucumber frame?
questions.zh: 彼得在黄瓜架附近遇到了谁？
options: A white cat / 一只白猫
questions.explanation: Peter meets Mr. McGregor at the end of a cucumber frame. / 彼得在黄瓜架尽头遇到了麦格先生。

questions.q: Which things does Peter lose or leave behind while escaping?
questions.zh: 彼得逃跑时丢失或留下了哪些穿戴物？
options: His hat and scarf / 帽子和围巾
His two shoes and blue jacket / 两只鞋和蓝色外套
His basket and umbrella / 篮子和雨伞
questions.explanation: Peter loses both shoes and leaves his blue jacket behind in the net. / 彼得丢了两只鞋，并把蓝色外套留在网子里。

questions.q: Where does Peter jump to hide, only to get wet?
questions.zh: 彼得跳进哪里躲藏，结果把自己弄湿了？
questions.explanation: Peter jumps into a can, but it contains so much water that he becomes damp. / 彼得跳进一个水壶，可里面有很多水，他因此浑身湿透。

questions.q: What does Mr. McGregor use Peter’s jacket and shoes for?
questions.zh: 麦格先生把彼得的外套和鞋子用来做什么？
options: To dress a scarecrow / 给稻草人穿戴
To repair the gate / 修理大门
To cover the wheelbarrow / 盖住独轮车
questions.explanation: Mr. McGregor hangs them on a scarecrow to frighten the blackbirds. / 麦格先生把它们挂在稻草人上，用来吓走乌鸫。

questions.q: What does Peter climb onto before he spots the gate?
questions.zh: 彼得看见大门前爬上了什么？
questions.explanation: Peter climbs onto a wheelbarrow and sees the gate beyond Mr. McGregor. / 彼得爬上独轮车，看见大门就在麦格先生身后。

evidenceQuoteFragments: till he got home to the big fir-tree
flopped down upon the nice soft sand
questions.q: Where does Peter finally stop and rest after escaping?
questions.zh: 彼得逃出来后，最后在哪里停下休息？
options: At home by the big fir-tree / 大杉树下的家中
Beside the garden pond / 花园池塘旁
Inside the baker’s shop / 面包店里
questions.explanation: Peter runs home to the big fir-tree and lies down on the soft sand in the rabbit-hole. / 彼得一路跑回大杉树下的家，躺在兔子洞的软沙地上。

questions.q: What does Mrs. Rabbit give Peter at bedtime?
questions.zh: 睡觉前，兔妈妈给彼得喝了什么？
questions.explanation: Mrs. Rabbit gives Peter one tablespoonful of camomile tea. / 兔妈妈给彼得喝了一汤匙洋甘菊茶。
